artworks.prompt: ONE original tall1290:2796 Glaze GHOSTPRESS wallpaper. An inkless blind dry-embossed illustration in heavy matte GRAPHITE COTTON-RAG PAPER. In lower45% a tangible invented harbour: low canal banks lead to a tiny inhabited lock-gate house above three sluice openings at lowerleft; a narrow counterweighted raised drawbridge crosses the canal to right; a small sharp-bowed vessel carries an enormous folded paper wave in its open hold. Clear constructed miniature places, visible doors/windows, mooring cleats and gate mechanisms, all integrated in one continuous impressed-paper scene, not pasted separate icons. Keep composition calm, all architecture small and low in frame. Upper55% quiet dark graphite paper grain with only subtle long sunken canal lines near the base. No ink/foil, colours come solely from sharp grazing warm-white light on pressed fibrous ridges and plum-gray recesses. Compressed paper fibres, clear embossed outlines, shallow low relief, no separate3D foam/plastic/stone miniature materials. Palette charcoal #26252D, gray #8D8790, ivory #EAE4DE highlights. No people, text, numerals, symbols, signs, clock/date/battery/weather readings, UI, logo, frame, phone mockup or collage. One continuous art wallpaper.
